5349.about: A ceremonial hall hung with flags: a silver-haired woman in a dark dress uniform and white gloves pins a decoration onto the chest of a young man in black tie, while a rank of soldiers in dress uniform stands to one side. She moves along the line to the next man and pins a medal on him too. The camera then pulls back to reveal the man she is decorating: his whole chest and stomach are plated with hundreds of medals and ribbons in overlapping rows, from collar to waist. He beams and laughs as she adds one more.
5349.question: What is the grey-haired woman doing?
5349.answer: She is pinning a medal on his jacket.

5351.about: Dusk on a road beside a bare-treed park. A woman in a red beret, a knitted scarf and a fur-hooded parka holds the camera at arm's length and pulls it along behind her, glancing back and laughing. Above and behind her an ornate cast-iron lamp on a tall post burns orange against the deep blue evening sky, and a line of the same lamps recedes along the road, their light pooling on the tarmac and the pavement. She leads on into a wide open square where strings of white lights hang overhead and more lit lamps stand along the edges.
5351.question: What is the woman looking at?
5351.answer: She is gazing up at the fairy lights.

5352.about: A young woman works late at a cluttered desk under a single angled lamp, a pencil clamped in her teeth, typing on a laptop half-buried in loose paper. Behind her the wall is papered with sticky notes and printouts, a tottering stack of documents rises beside the screen and her phone lies face-up on the table. She reads a sheet, then both hands fly to her head - she grips her hair, screws her face up and screams at the screen, then collapses forward with her head in her hands over the keyboard.
5352.question: What is the woman doing?
5352.answer: She is clutching her head in frustration.

5353.about: An open-plan office. A woman in a rust-coloured blouse sits at a desk with a corded handset wedged against her ear, talking into it while she reaches for a pink sticky note and taps at her keyboard. Around her the desk fills up with towers of loose printed sheets and ring binders - one stack to her left, another rising in front of the monitor, more piling up until they reach above her head and box her in. Colleagues move about in the background. She stops, puts the handset down and slumps forward onto the desk between the paper towers.
5353.question: What is piling up on her desk?
5353.answer: Paperwork is piling up on her desk.

5354.about: A group workout on a park lawn at golden hour, big trees behind and low sun flaring through the leaves. A woman in a grey crop top stands at the front with both arms stretched overhead, hands clasped, leaning to one side, and half a dozen people in gym clothes behind her copy the move. They drop into deep kneeling lunges with a hand on the front knee, then all jump on the spot swinging their arms up over their heads, then settle into wide side lunges with both arms held straight out, everyone moving together.

phrases.target: the man in the blue vest

5354.question: What is the class doing?
5354.answer: The class is exercising on the grass.

5355.about: Early morning in a misty park among tall thin trees, the sun burning through the haze. A woman in a coral top and leggings stands on a low stone platform leading a group of mostly older people through an exercise routine: arms stretched overhead with hands clasped, then a side bend, then bending down to touch her toes, with the whole group copying her behind. A large ginger cat walks along the stone ledge right beside her and stretches its front legs out with its back arched, matching her movement, then sits calmly at her feet while she and the group raise both arms to the sky.

phrases.en: to sit calmly at her feet

5355.question: What is the trainer doing?
5355.answer: She is leading a group workout.

5356.about: A rooftop terrace at sunset, city blocks and potted plants along the parapet, the sun a bright disc low in a hazy orange sky. A woman in a plum top and leggings works through poses on a mat: she folds forward with straight legs and both palms flat on the mat, looking up at the camera; rises into a high lunge with both arms lifted overhead and her gaze up; leans back over a straight rear leg with one arm reaching behind her; sits into a wide-legged forward fold reaching for one foot; and finally lies chest-down along her front leg with both arms stretched out on the mat in front of her.
5356.question: What is the woman doing?
5356.answer: She is practising yoga on a rooftop.

5357.about: A battered pram with patched fabric and rusty wheels rolls along a park path. Then a woman in a beige blazer pushes a plain modern grey stroller with a small fluffy dog sitting in it and the caption 500 euro appears. Finally a man in white robes pushes an ornate chrome carriage-style stroller with buttoned leather upholstery, the same dog inside wearing sunglasses, captioned 5000 euro, while the woman stares open-mouthed.
5357.question: What is the man in white pushing?
5357.answer: He is pushing a fancy pram.

5359.about: A ranger in a khaki uniform and cap stands on a wooden jetty over green river water and points behind her, eyes wide and mouth open in surprise. A large grey hippo floats just off the deck with its head and back above the water, then sinks lower and lower until only its nostrils and finally just ripples are left on the surface, while she keeps staring at the camera.
5359.question: What is the woman doing?
5359.answer: She is pointing at the hippo.

5360.about: A young man with bleached hair, glasses and a varsity jacket films himself pulling the camera along by the hand through an underground station. He taps through the ticket gate, stands on the platform as a train rolls in, steps into the carriage among other passengers, and then walks down a long underground corridor packed shoulder to shoulder with commuters, looking back at the camera with an astonished face.
5360.question: What is the young man doing?
5360.answer: He is walking through a crowded station.

5361.about: A woman in a striped top stands in a hallway with a small teal hard-shell cabin case, pulling its handle up, then heaves a much bigger navy soft suitcase down next to it and gestures at the two. The shot cuts to an airport hall where she is pushing a trolley loaded with six stacked suitcases in different colours, leaning into it with a strained face while the top case tips off the pile.

phrases.en: to carry a lot of suitcases

5361.question: What is the woman pushing?

5362.about: A young man with curly hair in an open cream shirt walks a whitewashed island street and lifts a pair of round dark sunglasses onto his face. He stops at a spinning rack of sunglasses outside a shop, tries on a pair of aviators, and then puts on enormous red heart-shaped sunglasses that cover half his face. He walks on to the harbour and poses proudly beside a blue and white fishing boat, pointing at himself while still wearing them.
5362.question: What is the young man wearing?
5362.answer: He is wearing silly red sunglasses.

5363.about: An exhausted female runner wearing race bib 134 is held up under both arms by a man in a grey cap and a young woman in a rainbow tri-suit at the end of a city road race. Spectators behind metal barriers clap and shout. The three walk her forward together across the finish line, then stop and fall into a tight group hug, crying and laughing.

phrases.en: to rush out of the crowd

5363.question: What are the two helpers doing?
5363.answer: They are aiding an exhausted runner.

5364.about: A young woman in an orange running vest is doubled over at a crowd barrier, sobbing with exhaustion. A man in a blue shirt and cap and another runner in a rainbow tri-suit each take one of her arms, lift her upright and walk her along the road past cheering spectators. The three finish together and end in a tearful hug.

phrases.en: to lean on her two helpers
phrases.target: the woman in the orange vest

phrases.en: to wear a pale blue cap

phrases.target: the woman in the rainbow suit

5364.question: What are the two helpers doing?
5364.answer: They are assisting an exhausted runner.

5365.about: A paintball player in a visored helmet and overalls covered in red and pink paint splatter crouches behind a wooden barricade, holding a paintball marker with a blue and red hopper. He looks down at the marker, lowers it, then raises one hand and finally stands up with both arms in the air while other players and a referee move across the field behind him.

phrases.en: to raise his hands in surrender

5365.question: What is the player doing?
5365.answer: He is raising his hands in surrender.

5366.about: A player in a paint-spattered boiler suit and helmet kneels behind a wooden barricade on a field of hay bales and oil drums, aiming a paintball marker. Paint bursts near him, he sets the marker down on the ground, raises one gloved hand, then stands up with both arms high above his head, grinning, as other players walk in behind him.

phrases.en: to aim from behind a barricade
to raise both hands in surrender

5366.question: What is the player doing?
5366.answer: He is surrendering with his hands up.

5367.about: At an outdoor eating contest a young woman with long braids in a tie-dye shirt tips a plastic cup of water into her mouth, her throat working as she gulps. She then takes a cheeseburger from the tray in front of her and forces bite after bite into her mouth as fast as she can, cheeks bulging, while a crowd behind the barrier claps and cheers. A wide shot shows a whole row of competitors doing the same along a long table.
5367.question: What is the woman with braids doing?
5367.answer: She is stuffing a burger into her mouth.

5369.about: A young boxer stands in a dim boxing gym with punchbags and other fighters training behind him. His grey shirt is soaked through with a big dark patch of sweat down the chest, his face and hair are wet, and he talks straight into the camera between hard breaths without softening. At the end he lifts a white towel with hands wrapped in red boxing wraps and rubs it over his head.

phrases.en: to talk straight into the camera

5369.question: What is he doing with the towel?
5369.answer: He is drying his hair with the towel.

5370.about: A man paddles a narrow yellow boat across grey water at eye level with the surface, passing a smooth rock islet with red wooden houses on it. The clip then follows him walking down a narrow cobbled old-town street between orange and yellow buildings, one hand brushing the wall. Finally he sits at an outdoor wooden table and bites into a large cinnamon bun dusted with icing sugar, a glass of latte in front of him.

phrases.en: to bite into a cinnamon bun
to stand on a rocky island

5370.question: What is he doing at the table?
5370.answer: He is biting into a cinnamon bun.

5371.about: At sunset beside a lake, a young woman in a white dress with a ring of flowers on her head ties a red ribbon to a tall birch pole that is wrapped in leaves and flowers. Four women, each wearing a flower ring on her head, then push the decorated pole upright against the orange sky. In the last shots a group of young people in the same flower rings hold hands and dance in a circle around the standing pole in a meadow of grass and wildflowers.
5371.question: What are the young women doing?
5371.answer: They are dancing around the decorated pole.

5372.about: A young man in a grey vest and shorts works his way across a white-tiled outdoor terrace, pulling a brush on a long wooden handle over the tiles and pushing scattered dry leaves into a growing heap. Palm trees, a parked car and a street are visible behind him; he works in flip-flops and the wet tiles reflect his shadow.

phrases.en: to lie in a big pile

5372.question: What is the man doing?

5373.about: In a sunny back garden, three people stand at a picnic table watching a striped beach ball get bigger and bigger until it fills the frame. A glass bowl of dough on the same table then rises until it bulges over the rim. Next a woman on the lawn watches a blue paddling pool grow out to its full size, and finally the whole group stands watching a yellow and blue bouncy castle rise up into a full castle with towers.
5373.question: What is the dough doing?
5373.answer: It is rising over the rim of the bowl.

5374.about: A man swims front crawl through bright turquoise sea that is so low and clear that the sandy bottom and his own shadow are visible right underneath him. Boats sit on the horizon and a dolphin leaps out of the water behind him. At the end he stops swimming and kneels beside a pale sandbank, the water reaching only to his chest.
5374.question: What is the man doing?
5374.answer: He is swimming through shallow water.

5375.about: A blonde woman in an orange shirt stands in a bay at a golf driving range and takes a full shot: the club travels in a wide arc over her shoulder and she watches the ball fly out over the green. The clip then cuts to a lake, where she grips a thick rope hanging from a gum tree, runs off the bank and rides the rope out over the water in a long curve before hanging from it above the lake.

phrases.en: to swing out over the lake

5375.question: What is she doing over the lake?
5375.answer: She is swinging on a thick rope.

5376.about: A young man in a denim shirt stands in a dark flat at night and reaches for a white plate on the wall by the door. The lights come on and he grins into the camera in the warm light. A close-up shows his hand pressing the small white rocker on the wall plate, and the last shot pans across the now brightly lit living room with its ceiling spots, floor lamp and dining table.

phrases.en: to gaze around the living room

5376.question: What is he doing in the dark?
5376.answer: He is flipping a light switch.

5378.about: Three short scenes around tables. A young man in a grey T-shirt puts a mug down on a small folding table in a hallway, then rocks the table to show how it wobbles. In a bright kitchen a woman puts glasses and colourful plates down one by one around a wooden table, laying a place in front of every chair. Finally a man in a blue suit stands at the head of an enormous banquet table in a marble hall and opens his arms over it, where candles, flowers, glasses and plates have all been put in their places down its whole length.
5378.question: What is the woman doing?

5380.about: A cardboard box with FREE STUFF written on the side stands on a low garden wall in a quiet suburban street. A cyclist in a racing jersey and helmet reaches in and lifts a table lamp out of it. A bearded man in a hoodie reaches in and lifts out an American football. An elderly woman with a walking stick lifts out a terracotta plant pot. Finally a young man with a backpack looks into the empty box, picks up the box itself and carries it away down the pavement.

phrases.en: to pull out a table lamp
to grab a stack of books

5380.question: What is the cyclist doing?
5380.answer: He is taking a lamp out of the box.

5381.about: Four short scenes of people speaking with each other. A man in a hoodie walks along a busy New York street with a phone at his ear, answering and gesturing with his free hand. Two women in a cafe lean towards each other over their cappuccinos, one telling something and the other reacting with wide eyes. An elderly woman and a middle-aged man stand on either side of a white picket fence in a sunny front garden and lean in to talk across it. Finally a family around a lit dinner table talk over each other, pointing and laughing.

phrases.en: to laugh with her eyes closed

5381.question: What are the two women doing?
5381.answer: They are talking in a cafe.

5383.about: A young woman in a leopard-print coat stands at the edge of a very wide city street, one arm raised to hail a cab. The camera looks straight down the avenue: several lanes wide, lined with tall buildings on both sides and packed with yellow taxis stretching to the horizon. She pulls a wheeled suitcase, turns to the camera grinning, then holds her arm out over the crosswalk again as taxis roll past her.
5383.question: What is the woman doing?
5383.answer: She is hailing a taxi on the avenue.

5385.about: A group in matching yellow shirts huddles in a tight circle on a blue outdoor volleyball court, heads together, psyching each other up. They break and play: one dives flat to dig the ball, another jumps at the net and smashes it over, the opposing players jump to block. The rally ends in their favour and the whole squad runs together into one big hug, jumping and shouting under palm trees and a bright blue sky.

phrases.en: to huddle in a tight circle
to play volleyball under palm trees

5385.question: What are the players celebrating?

5386.about: A woman in a grey suit stands at the head of a glass boardroom table, a row of men in suits seated on both sides. She holds a printed contract up in front of her and rips it in half, then drops a thick stack of paper onto the table and pulls sheet after sheet apart, letting the pieces fall. The table ends up covered in torn and crumpled paper. She walks out past a framed contract on an easel while the seated men stare.

phrases.en: to tear a contract in half
to walk out of the meeting

5386.question: What is the woman in grey doing?
5386.answer: She is tearing a contract in half.

5387.about: An extreme close-up of an eye with a tear welling up and rolling down the cheek. The shot widens to two friends lying together on a sofa at night under a thick knitted blanket, both crying, faces screwed up. One pulls tissues from a box on the blanket and hands one over; they dab their eyes and blow their noses, then lean their heads together and keep watching, still in tears.
5387.question: What are the two women doing?
5387.answer: They are crying under a knitted blanket.

5388.about: In a living room a tall young man in a band T-shirt holds a big orange packet of crisps high above his head, out of reach, mouth open in mock shock. A young woman in a football kit stretches up and grabs for it; he keeps swinging the packet away and laughing while she circles him. She finally gets both hands on it, walks off with it, and sits on the sofa holding the packet open and eating from it.

phrases.en: to hold crisps out of reach

5388.question: What is the man doing?
5388.answer: He is holding the packet out of reach.

5389.about: In a bright living room a young man holds an orange snack packet up over his head while a young woman in a red football kit jumps for it. Every time she lunges he twists sharply away, ducking low and darting sideways across the rug so her hands miss him. He crouches, spins past her and keeps the packet out of her reach, until she finally corners him, takes it, and they both sit down on the sofa with it, laughing.
5389.question: What is the man doing?
5389.answer: He is dodging her outstretched hands.

5390.about: Handheld phone footage at a sunny skatepark and the adjoining basketball court. A boy in a dark hooded sweatshirt rides a skateboard across the concrete and steps off; another boy stands watching him from the far side of the bowl while more boys wait on the grass. Three boys shoot a basketball at an outdoor hoop. Then about ten teenage boys in hoodies and caps press into a tight ring around one phone, pointing at the screen, shouting and laughing, a backpack lying on the grass at their feet.

phrases.target: the boy in the purple cap

5390.question: What are the boys doing?
5390.answer: They are looking at a phone.

5391.about: Evening at a park with the sun low behind the trees. A boy in a black hoodie rolls across the flat concrete of a skatepark on his skateboard while four friends watch from the ramp behind him. On the basketball court another boy throws the ball up towards the hoop against the setting sun and catches it again. Then five teenagers sit shoulder to shoulder on a bench in front of the hoop, leaning in over one boy's phone with their eyes fixed on the screen and their mouths open, before they all break into laughter.
5391.question: What are the teenagers doing?
5391.answer: They are staring at the phone screen.

5392.about: A selfie-style shot inside the dark corridor of a haunted-house attraction, the walls lined with neon strips and glowing signs. A woman with a lilac bob in a denim jacket and a man in a yellow hoodie edge forward with their eyes wide and their mouths open. A grinning zombie head lights up on the wall beside them, then a clown mask appears further down the passage. The two clutch each other, the woman gripping his arm and then his shoulder, and both scream straight into the camera as they back away.

phrases.en: to wrap his arm around her

5392.question: What is the woman doing?
5392.answer: She is clinging to his arm in terror.

5393.about: A living room strung with fairy lights, the television on in the corner. A woman wrapped in a grey blanket walks in carrying a big bowl of popcorn. A person in an inflatable green T-rex costume rears up from behind the black sofa and lunges at her. She throws the popcorn into the air so it rains all over the floor, drops down beside the bookshelf and pulls the blanket right over her head, until only her wide frightened eyes are showing.

phrases.en: to balance a bowl of popcorn

5393.question: Where is the woman hiding?
5393.answer: She is cowering under a grey blanket.

5396.about: Two rangers in matching khaki uniforms work on green coastal hills. They spread a white map over the bonnet of their truck and study it, then carry wooden stakes topped with orange flags up the slope and push them into the ground one after another, so that a line of orange flags curves over the ridge. An aerial shot shows the finished flag line running across the hillside down towards the sea, and one ranger steps back, takes off her hat and looks along it.
5396.question: What is the woman doing?
5396.answer: She is marking a line with orange flags.

5400.about: A woman in a green velvet dress sits in the audience of a plain little hall, clapping as two men in waistcoats bow on a low wooden platform; she turns to the camera, delighted. Then she is alone in a large empty auditorium of red seats, looking up at the stage. Finally she leans on the red-and-gold rail of a box in a grand horseshoe-shaped opera house, a chandelier above her, tiers of gilded balconies around her and the orchestra playing in the pit below the closed red curtain.
5400.question: What is the woman wearing?
5400.answer: She is wearing a green dress.

5401.about: A black-and-white montage of five people puzzling over something they want to figure out: a young woman in a kitchen holds a pen against her chin and stares upward with a frown; a man at a chess board in a library hovers his hand over a piece; a teenager in a hoodie presses a hand over his eyes; a student in a jumper bites her pen over an open notebook; finally a young woman at a kitchen table gasps with delight and starts writing on her papers.
5401.question: What is the man doing?

5402.about: In a clinic a female doctor in a white coat and headscarf holds a wooden tongue depressor and looks into the wide-open mouth of a young man in a pink polo shirt. He then stands at a water cooler and drinks from a bottle with his hand on his chest; a close-up shows his neck and Adam's apple moving as he swallows, his head tilted back. At the end he faces the camera and speaks, looking relieved.
5402.question: What is the doctor doing?

5403.about: A young woman in a beige trench coat stands at a glass tram shelter and runs her finger down a printed timetable, then looks at her wristwatch and smiles. At a station concourse she reads a large departure board full of times and writes in a small spiral notepad. Back on the platform she compares the posted timetable with her watch again while a red train pulls in behind her.
5403.question: What is the woman looking at?
5403.answer: She is looking at her watch.

5404.about: A young man in a bright kitchen leans over a stainless-steel toaster and pushes the lever down. Two slices of toast pop up and he gasps with delight, then lifts them onto a white plate. He keeps going: slice after slice comes out of the toaster and he adds each one to the plate until the toast has grown into a tower far taller than the toaster itself. He grins over the top of the stack, buttering the topmost slice and reaching for still more.
5404.question: What is the man making?
5404.answer: He is making a lot of toast.

5405.about: A baby in a striped bodysuit stands on a fluffy living-room rug and takes wobbly first steps towards two adults who kneel a few feet away, clapping and cheering it on. The film cuts to a bright daycare room where several small children in T-shirts toddle unsteadily between coloured foam blocks, and then to a wide view of the same room full of little children walking around low tables and small chairs.

phrases.en: to clamber onto a foam block

5405.question: What is the baby in stripes doing?
5405.answer: The baby is taking wobbly first steps.

5406.about: A close shot of hot beach sand shows a pair of bare feet with the toes spread wide, and a white shell lying in the sand right in front of them. A young woman in a tie-dye T-shirt, denim shorts and a visor steps forward, treads straight onto the shell and jerks her foot up with a pained laugh. She hops on one leg, grabs the sore foot and shakes it out, then bounds away across the sand and jumps onto a striped beach towel.
5406.question: What is the woman stepping on?
5406.answer: She is stepping on a shell.

5407.about: At a house party lit by coloured lights, a young woman in a sequin jacket stands in the narrow hallway knocking on a closed white door with her phone in her other hand. Nothing happens, so she waits and checks the phone. Behind her a queue builds up as several other guests line up along the hallway. Finally the door swings open onto a small bathroom with a white toilet bowl and a towel beside it, and the next guest squeezes past her to get in.
5407.question: What are the guests waiting for?
5407.answer: They are waiting for the toilet.

5408.about: A woman in a denim shirt and a patterned headband stands in an open garage with a wooden kitchen chair in front of her; she presses on the seat and it wobbles. She turns to a red hard case on the bench and opens it: inside, held in moulded slots, are rows of screwdrivers, spanners, pliers and sockets. She lifts one screwdriver out of the case, tightens the loose joint under the chair, stands the chair back up and sits down on it to show it holds.
5408.question: What is the woman fixing?

5409.about: A young woman with freckles smiles into the camera and pulls her lower lip down with one finger to show her front teeth close up. The film cuts to a dental surgery where she sits in the chair in a mint jumper while a dentist holds a small round mirror up to her open mouth. Then she is outside under a tree, biting into a big red apple, and finally she holds up the bitten apple and grins straight at the camera.
5409.question: What is the young woman eating?
5409.answer: She is eating a red apple.

5410.about: A close shot shows a blue-and-white tube squeezing a stripe of pale blue paste onto the bristles of a small green-and-white brush. A young man in blue pyjamas then stands at the bathroom mirror scrubbing his front teeth with it and working it around his mouth. He bends over the basin, rinses with water from his cupped hand and spits, then straightens up, smiles at his reflection and stands the brush in a white cup beside the tap.

phrases.en: to stand in a white cup

5410.question: What is the man doing?

5411.about: A man at a bathroom basin screws up his face as he squeezes hard on an almost empty tube, getting barely a smear onto his brush. The film cuts to a young woman in a green towel headband at a bright counter with three blue toothbrushes laid out in front of her. She holds a full tube over each brush and squeezes out a thick coil of mint-green paste, winding it round and round into a fat spiral on every one, then looks up at the camera wide-eyed at the three big swirls.
5411.question: What is the young woman doing?
5411.answer: She is squeezing toothpaste onto three toothbrushes.

5412.about: Phone footage of a guided tour through an ancient Greek hilltop site. The camera moves up a stone ramp between rows of huge fluted marble pillars that carry the roof of a ruined gateway, following a guide who holds a red umbrella up above the group. The tour walks out into an open ruined courtyard where tourists stop and photograph the walls, then the clip cuts to a viewpoint at sunset where a large crowd on a paved terrace looks across the city at the temple standing on its rock.

phrases.en: to stand out from the crowd
to carry a green tote bag
phrases.target: the man with the green bag
the woman in the dark dress

5412.question: What are the tourists doing?
5412.answer: The tourists are photographing the ancient ruins.

5414.about: Phone footage from inside a car stuck in morning traffic. A schoolboy in a white shirt and dark tie sits by the open window with cars packed around him and leans out to look along the jammed lanes as scooters squeeze past. He then walks up the steps of a pedestrian footbridge and takes hold of its metal railing with both hands, standing at the horizontal bar between its upright supports and looking down at hundreds of cars filling every lane of the hazy motorway below.
5414.question: What is the boy holding?
5414.answer: He is holding the metal rail.

5415.about: A delivery rider on a scooter waits at a city junction, filmed head-on. The traffic light on the pole behind him shows green, then switches to red - the round red lamp and the red pedestrian figure lit up right above his helmet - and he stays sitting still on the bike. When it goes green again he looks up and rides on. The clip ends on a wide view down a six-lane avenue where rows of motorbikes and cars wait under a line of traffic lights.

phrases.en: to look up at the light
to smile at the green light

5415.question: What is the man looking at?
5415.answer: He is looking at the traffic light.

5416.about: A woman with a wheeled suitcase stands on a station platform on a bright day. A train comes in on the far track, then a bright orange electric locomotive rolls slowly past her at the head of its carriages, close enough to fill the frame, and she turns and beams at it. A blue regional train passes on the next track, and the clip cuts to a glass-roofed station hall where the long white nose of a high-speed train slides in beside the platform.
5416.question: What is the woman staring at?
5416.answer: She is staring at the passing trains.

5418.about: A woman in a mustard coat climbs the wooden steps up into an old red tram from the street. The camera follows her inside, where the whole carriage is visible from within: varnished wooden benches, a wooden floor, brass handrails and windows on both sides. She leans out through the open side of the carriage and grins as the cobbled street and old houses pass. At the end she steps out of the tram onto a station platform where a long modern white tram is waiting.

phrases.en: to lean out of the carriage

5418.question: What is the woman holding?
5418.answer: She is holding a brass pole.

5419.about: A man with a backpack jumps out of an underground metro train and runs across the station floor towards the stairs. Outside he sprints along the pavement towards a red and white tram waiting at a stop, then keeps running down a city street to catch a bus at the kerb. Finally he runs up a metal gangway onto a passenger ferry at a harbour quay, with cranes across the water behind him.
5419.question: What is the traveller doing?
5419.answer: The traveller is rushing to catch a ferry.

5420.about: A man in an olive jacket with a backpack walks off a metro train onto the platform among other passengers, then jogs along a sunny street towards a red and cream tram and steps up through its open door. He then runs across a stone quay past flying seagulls towards the water, where a white passenger boat with a small wheelhouse and an open deck is moored. He walks up the metal gangway and steps aboard the boat.
5420.question: What is he doing at the harbour?
5420.answer: He is boarding a passenger vessel.

5422.about: A young man in a red beanie and a checked shirt sits on a park bench and squashes a piece of rubbish into a ball in his hands, then drops it into a round steel park bin beside the bench. He walks on past a big green metal dumpster on a city pavement, looking back at the camera. In a wide open square he throws a piece of rubbish in a high arc towards a long row of colour-coded bins, each marked with a recycling symbol, and watches it fly in.

phrases.en: to stand beside a park bench

5422.question: What is he doing in the square?
5422.answer: He is tossing litter into the recycling bins.

5423.about: One traveller with a large red rucksack appears in three completely different parts of the world in a row. First he walks across the wide stone square in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris under a blue sky. Then he is sitting in a long narrow boat under a striped canopy, riding through a floating market where sellers in conical hats hold trays of vegetables out of their boats, and he reaches over to one of them. Finally he is walking over flat white snow in a green sun hat, with icebergs on the horizon and penguins standing behind him.
5423.question: What is he doing in the snow?
5423.answer: He is spreading his arms wide.

5425.about: Outdoors in a sunny garden full of palms, a young woman in a teal blazer and a young man in a grey suit sit side by side at a long wooden table, each with an open document folder in front of them. A crowd of colleagues in business clothes stands packed behind their chairs. Two small desk flags, one teal and one orange, sit at the front edge of the table. Both sign their documents, the colleagues clap, and then the two stand up and shake hands.
5425.question: What is the man in grey carrying?
5425.answer: He is carrying a blue folder.

5426.about: In a green courtyard, two groups in business clothes meet at a long wooden table. A woman in a teal blazer and a man in a grey suit sit at the table with open document folders while four colleagues stand in a line behind them, two on each side. Two small desk flags, teal and orange, stand between the folders. The camera moves in as both sign their papers, then the two signers rise and shake hands while their groups look on.

phrases.en: to glance up at the camera

5426.question: What is the seated woman wearing?
5426.answer: She is wearing a teal blazer.

5427.about: In a dark theatre lit by warm lamps, a laughing young woman holds a cream envelope up to the camera; the flap is closed with a round red wax seal pressed with a stamp. A young man in a green hoodie then shakes his hands in front of his chest and pulls a wide-eyed, nervous face. The shot cuts to a group of young people on a lit stage who jump, scream, hug each other and celebrate.

phrases.en: to hold up a sealed envelope
to wear a dark green hoodie
phrases.target: the boy in the green hoodie

5427.question: What is the ponytailed woman holding?
5427.answer: She is clutching a gold trophy.

5428.about: A logistics yard under a clear blue sky. A bearded worker in a hi-vis jacket and work gloves stands beside a pickup stacked with shrink-wrapped pallets of cardboard boxes and pats the load. He turns and waves a large chrome-fronted American semi-truck forward; it rolls in towing a rusty steel shipping container, the driver waving from the high cab. The worker guides it past him along the gravel and grins as the container rolls by.
5428.question: What is the truck towing?
5428.answer: It is towing a shipping container.

5429.about: In a bright sports hall, a blonde woman in black training clothes stands on a wooden plyo box with her arms folded and her eyes shut. A group of men and women in gym gear form two facing lines below her and stretch their arms out with their palms up, hands interlocked. She lets herself fall straight backwards without looking; the group catches her in their linked hands and lowers her gently. Everyone laughs and claps and she grins.
5429.question: What is the woman doing?

5430.about: A selfie-stick POV of a young woman riding a road bike at speed on a mountain road. She rushes out of a dark tunnel into green forest, keeps pedalling along the open road, races through a white-tiled underpass, then through a lit road tunnel where a car passes her, and finally approaches another arched tunnel mouth. The road, walls and trees stream past her the whole time while she grins into the camera.
5430.question: What is the woman doing?
5430.answer: She is riding a bike fast.

5431.about: A travel montage. A red-haired woman films herself from the wicker basket of a hot air balloon at dawn over Cappadocia, with dozens of striped balloons drifting at different heights above the rock valley and its stone spires. The clip then cuts to a covered bazaar lined with blue patterned ceramics and hanging glass lamps, where her finger points at the shelves, and finally to her on a ferry deck at dusk sipping a tulip glass of Turkish tea while gulls fly past over the water.

phrases.en: to drink a glass of tea

5431.question: What is the woman drinking?
5431.answer: She is drinking a glass of tea.

5432.about: An evening street stall hung with rows of brass bells. A young ice cream seller in a red fez and an embroidered red waistcoat works the stretchy ice cream with a long metal paddle, lifting a heavy rope of it into the air. He holds a cone out to a customer, and each time the customer reaches for it he flips the paddle and takes the cone away again, ringing the bells and laughing while the customer keeps grabbing at nothing. In the end he hands the cone over.
5432.question: What is the ice cream seller doing?

5433.about: A young man in a yellow kurta walks backwards through a house at dusk, filming himself. He stops at a wall switch inside the veranda and flips it, then walks out into the garden past potted plants and palm trees to a switch box on a pole. He flips that one too and strings of fairy lights come on all across the house front, the palms and the garden, turning the blue evening bright. He looks up at the lights and grins.

phrases.en: to gaze up at the lights
to gather by the front door

5433.question: What is the man looking at?
5433.answer: He is gazing up at the lights.

5434.about: Inside a flat at dusk, a woman in an oversized mustard hoodie switches on one appliance after another. She flicks the steel kettle on its base, then the white desk fan on the kitchen counter, which starts spinning. She crouches on the floor and taps the button on a round robot vacuum until its blue light comes on and it starts moving. She picks up a white power strip from the sofa and pushes a plug into it, and the sockets light up. Coloured fairy lights come on along the walls and she throws her arms wide, laughing in the lit room.
5434.question: What is the woman doing?
5434.answer: She is flinging her arms wide.

5436.about: A run of short kitchen clips, each one showing hands turning something round on itself. A woman grips a soaked blue cloth with both fists and twists it in opposite directions over the sink until the water runs out of it; a pair of hands twists the metal lid off a jar of pickles; hands twist a rope of pale dough over on itself on a floured worktop; a young woman twists a long braid of dough while a friend watches; finally six teenagers line up along the counter, take hold of one enormous rope of dough and twist it together until flour bursts into the air.

phrases.en: to wring out a wet cloth

5436.question: What is the blonde woman squeezing?
5436.answer: She is squeezing a wet cloth.

5437.about: A travel reel in three parts. First a young woman in a white embroidered shirt leads the camera by the hand through a field of sunflowers at sunset. Then she walks across a cobbled cathedral square as a flock of pigeons takes off around her in front of a white church with golden domes. Finally the clip ends in the paved courtyard of an old manor: the walls and arcades of the building close the space in on every side, strings of warm lights hang overhead, and a long table of guests in embroidered shirts claps and cheers as she lifts a big braided loaf of bread above her head.
5437.question: What is the woman raising?
5437.answer: She is raising a braided loaf.

5438.about: A woman in a red embroidered apron makes dumplings on a big wooden table in a log kitchen. A white bowl of dark red fruit filling stands at her elbow next to a lump of dough and a row of flat dough circles; she takes each circle, closes it around a spoonful of the filling and presses the edge shut, laying the finished half-moons out in rows across the table. She carries a full board of them to a wide black pan of boiling water over an open fire while a small boy in an embroidered shirt watches, tastes one from a spoon over the steaming pan, and finally sets a wooden bowl of cooked dumplings on the table beside the bowl of red filling.
5438.question: What is the woman tasting?
5438.answer: She is tasting a steaming dumpling.

5439.about: A rainy street in a Japanese city, everything in the shot somewhere between white and black. The sky is a flat grey ceiling of cloud, the wet road and the concrete buildings are grey, and the only colour is the rainbow-striped umbrella a young man in a beige coat shakes open over his head. He swaps it for a plain dark grey umbrella and walks up the middle of the shining wet road as the rain gets heavier, until four men in suits crowd together under that one grey umbrella, shoulder to shoulder in the downpour, the city behind them washed out to grey.
5439.question: What are the four men sharing?
5439.answer: They are sharing a grey umbrella.

5441.about: A family barbecue in a green backyard. A big bearded man in sunglasses and a bright Hawaiian shirt runs a small boy around the lawn in a wheelbarrow while the boy throws his arms up and shouts. At the grill another man in a blue T-shirt turns the meat; two little girls stand in front of the smoke holding handfuls of marshmallows and grin at the camera. The bearded man then sits down at the picnic table and arm-wrestles one of the girls, letting her push his hand down while she laughs, and the clip ends wide on the whole family carrying children on their shoulders around the smoking grill and the loaded picnic table.

phrases.target: the man in the colourful shirt

phrases.en: to cook meat on the grill
phrases.target: the man in the blue T-shirt

5441.question: Who is sitting in the wheelbarrow?
5441.answer: A boy is sitting in the wheelbarrow.

5442.about: A very large bearded man stands just inside a log cabin with snow visible through the window and peels off his winter kit layer by layer. He holds his heavy black parka open, shrugs his arms out of its sleeves and drops it, unwinds a long grey knitted scarf from his neck, pulls off his grey beanie, then grabs the hem of his fleece top and drags it up over his head, his arms coming out of the sleeves last. He steps out of his padded black ski trousers, kicks a boot off, and ends standing barefoot in a green thermal base layer with the discarded clothes heaped on the bench behind him.
5442.question: What is the man taking off?
5442.answer: He is removing his winter clothes.

5444.about: In the bright white atrium of a museum, a group of young adults builds one giant floor jigsaw together. They carry big foam puzzle pieces shaped like countries across the tiled floor, kneel down and slot them into place at the edges of a huge coloured world map that is slowly taking shape. Two of them lift one long black piece between them and lower it into the gap; another crouches to push an orange piece into the outline; a woman in a headscarf lays a piece into the row beside them. Passers-by stop and watch from the sides. When the last pieces are in, the group stands back, laughs and throws their hands up for a high five over the finished map.
5444.question: What are the young people doing?
5444.answer: They are cooperating to build a giant jigsaw.

5446.about: A short travel montage of a young woman in a mustard-yellow raincoat. First she leans out of a red telephone box on a city street, one arm raised in a wave, with a huge clock tower behind her and a red double-decker bus passing. Then she is out on a green hillside where low grey cloud sits right down on the hills: the far slopes fade into white haze and the long lake in the valley below is half swallowed by it, so you cannot see where the hills end. She walks along the ridge in the drizzle, looking out over the hazy valley. Finally she stands on a wooden seaside pier under a clear blue sky, laughing and eating chips out of a paper cone with the surf rolling in behind her.

phrases.en: to drive past the phone box

5446.question: What is she looking at?
5446.answer: She is looking at a misty valley.

5448.about: A young man in a red jacket with a backpack turns on the spot in the middle of a busy city crossing, arms flung wide and mouth open in delight. All around and above him the building fronts are covered floor to roof in enormous lit advertising boards - bright pink, blue and white panels the size of whole walls, stacked one above the other and wrapped around the corners of the towers - while yellow taxis and crowds pass behind him. The clip then cuts to him leaning on the rail of a ferry, grinning, with a tall green statue on an island behind him, and finally to him standing on a rock at the rim of a huge red canyon at sunset with his arms raised.
5448.question: What is he doing on the ferry?
5448.answer: He is leaning over the railing.

5449.about: A woman in a pale blue dress arrives at an old stone house. A hand holding a bunch of keys opens the flap of a brass letterbox set into the stone wall. She then goes to a tall wooden double door and fits a key into it, working the lock. At a second, darker wooden door she pushes a huge iron key into the lock beside an iron bar and a padlock, turns it with both hands and lifts the bar clear. Finally she pulls both heavy leaves of the door apart and stands in the middle of the open stone opening they leave in the wall, with the sunlit courtyard behind her - a cypress tree, wisteria on the wall and gravel underfoot.

phrases.en: to turn a huge iron key
to dangle below the iron bar

5449.question: Where is the woman standing?
5449.answer: She is standing in the doorway.

5450.about: A young woman walks through her flat switching everything off at the wall: she pulls a black cable out of a socket beside a cabinet, then in the kitchen she reaches behind the worktop and pulls the plug of a toaster and a coffee machine, then a tall standing fan in the hallway, and finally the wall-mounted TV with its LED light strips, which go dark as she reaches up and disconnects it.
5450.question: What is the woman doing?
5450.answer: She is unplugging all her devices.

5451.about: In a bright clinic waiting room a nurse in a white coat holds up a small glass vial and shows it to a young man in a green t-shirt sitting on a chair. She swabs his upper arm and pushes the needle of a syringe into it while he watches and smiles. A round plaster is stuck on the spot, and he stands up and flexes his bicep proudly while other patients wait in the background.
5451.question: What is the nurse doing?
5451.answer: She is giving him an injection.

5452.about: A man wrapped in a thick checked blanket stands alone at the end of a wooden pier on a mountain lake, sipping slowly from a metal mug. Thick white mist hangs over the water at first; as it drifts away the turquoise lake, the pine forest and the snow-topped rock faces appear behind him, perfectly still and mirrored in the water. He keeps looking out, drinking, and nothing else moves.
5452.question: What is the man holding?

5453.about: An older woman stands at a wooden kitchen table with a tall dark blue ceramic vase in front of her. She pours water into it from a glass jug, then takes flowers from a pile on the table one by one and puts them into the vase: a pink peony, big yellow sunflowers, white daisies. At the end she holds the vase with both hands and turns it to show the full arrangement, then leans in and smells it.
5453.question: What is the woman doing?
5453.answer: She is arranging flowers in a vase.

5455.about: A young man in a blue t-shirt with a backpack stands in a crowded government office, clutching a black document folder to his chest and staring ahead, tense. Behind a glass counter a woman in a navy blazer leafs through a booklet, then lays an open passport on a sheet of holographic security stickers and presses one into it. She slides the finished passport back across the counter. The young man opens it, sees the page, and breaks into a huge grin while the people waiting behind him hold up cards marked 10.
5455.question: What is the young man doing?
5455.answer: He is beaming at his passport.

5457.about: A young woman with a long red braid and a young man carrying a pink and blue box walk up to a small blue wooden cottage buried in hanging flowers. The bright blue door opens and an old woman in a headscarf leans out, beaming at them; she comes onto the step and the two young people wrap her in a hug. Inside the low wooden kitchen they lift a cream cake out of its box onto a small table beside a jar of sunflowers, the young woman pours from a white kettle into enamel mugs, and all three lean over the cake together, laughing.
5457.question: What is the young man carrying?
5457.answer: He is carrying a pink box.

5460.about: At a funfair a young man staggers away from a spinning teacup ride with his hand clamped over his mouth and his eyes bulging. He hurries to a grey bin and doubles over it. More riders come off the ride the same way: a young woman covers her mouth with both hands, another man clamps his hand over his and bends forward, and soon a whole row of people is bent over the bins along the walkway while the carousel and the big wheel keep turning behind them.

phrases.en: to turn green in the face

5460.question: What are the people doing?
5460.answer: They are bending over the rubbish bins.

5461.about: Inside a school hall set up with cardboard privacy screens, a clear plastic box already half full of folded white papers stands on a table. A woman in a yellow blouse posts her folded paper through the slot in the lid and smiles. A tattooed young man walks up the aisle holding his paper and drops it in, watched by the queue behind him. An older man in a striped polo shirt pushes his paper through the slot, then a woman in a wheelchair reaches up and posts hers. The queue keeps moving and an official sits at a desk beside the box.
5461.question: What is the wheelchair user doing?
5461.answer: She is dropping her ballot into the box.

5462.about: In a community hall a clear plastic box stands on a folding table with a tall stack of folded white papers piled in front of it and more already inside. A woman in a mustard blouse steps up smiling with her hand on her chest. A young man in a white t-shirt pushes his folded paper through the slot in the lid, then an older man in a blue polo shirt posts his while the others wait and smile. A woman in a wheelchair holds hers ready and a helper in blue sits at the table. At the end the whole group stands around the full box, pleased.

phrases.en: to stand on a folding table

5462.question: What is the woman in mustard doing?
5462.answer: She is resting her hand on her chest.

5463.about: A young man in a grey wool coat stands at the rail of a ship pulling away from a harbour town of red and white houses and waves back at the shore. Out on open grey water he wedges himself against the mast, opens a small black hardback book and writes in it with a blue pen, smiling as the waves break past. Later, in golden evening light, he stands at the white rail writing in the same book while the ship passes tall sea cliffs topped by a lighthouse, then looks up from the page in amazement.
5463.question: What is the young man doing?
5463.answer: He is writing in his journal.

5465.about: In a fabric shop lined with stacked bolts of cloth and a wall of coloured thread spools, a smiling young woman in a rust-orange jumpsuit stands while an older man with a yellow tape measure runs it around the narrow middle of her body and reads the number. The shot moves in close on her middle as she fastens a wide woven red belt around it. She then steps back and spins a hula hoop around the same part of her body, laughing with her arms raised, a sewing machine and workbench behind her.
5465.question: What is the young woman doing?
5465.answer: She is spinning a hula hoop around her waist.

5467.about: A brightly painted bunk room at a summer camp with open windows onto trees. A teenage boy on a top bunk jolts out of sleep with his eyes wide and his mouth open, then sits up and rubs his face with both hands while another child still lies asleep on the bunk below. The camera moves across the room and the whole dormitory comes out of sleep: children push back their duvets, sit up on the edges of their bunks and rub their eyes, with sandals and flip-flops on the floor beside the beds.
5467.question: What is the boy on top doing?

5469.about: An older woman with short white hair, a cap and a bright pink jacket makes her way on foot along a gravel path in a lakeside park, planting a Nordic walking pole with each hand as she goes. She passes another person on foot near a bench, then follows the path beside grey water with ducks on it, stops to look at the smartwatch on her wrist, and carries on past a stone fountain with hills and a town on the far shore.

phrases.en: to shoot a jet of water

5469.question: What is the woman holding?
5469.answer: She is gripping two walking poles.

5470.about: A montage of people walking. First a low shot follows a woman in a navy business suit and nude high heels striding along a city sidewalk past taxis and office workers; then she is seen from behind crossing a street between glass skyscrapers in the financial district. The scene cuts to a bald hiker with a big backpack and trekking poles climbing a forest trail towards a mountain; then to a man in a blue t-shirt walking a golden retriever on a leash across a sunny park lawn; and finally to a high aerial view of a huge crowd streaming across the Shibuya-style crossing between illuminated billboards downtown.

phrases.en: to stride in nude high heels
to hike up a forest trail
to trot along on a leash

5470.question: What is the hiker carrying?
5470.answer: He is carrying a bulky backpack.

5471.about: A young man in a paint-spattered t-shirt is decorating a bare white wall in a flat with a wooden floor. He holds a black-framed picture up against the wall and shifts it until it sits straight, then lays a yellow spirit level along the top edge of a framed flower painting and watches the bubble. He hangs a striped woven textile beside the frames, adds two wooden shelves with potted plants and a decorative leaf clock, and by the end the whole wall is a dense gallery of aligned frames. A step ladder stands to one side and he steps back, hands on hips, to look at the finished wall.

phrases.en: to rest against a picture frame

5471.question: Where is the man resting his hands?
5471.answer: He is resting his hands on his hips.

5473.about: A man with a moustache in a brown corduroy jacket and a striped shoulder bag stands at a shop checkout, pulling a blue bank card out of a brown leather wallet next to the card terminal. He then walks through an open-air fruit market and opens the same wallet in front of the fruit crates, searching through it. He lifts the wallet up to the camera with both hands and turns it around so the empty pockets show, grinning in disbelief. Finally he leans over a wooden table where a small pile of loose coins has been tipped out, and pushes the coins around with both hands while another person's hand reaches in from the other side.

phrases.en: to pull out a bank card

5473.question: What is pouring onto the table?
5473.answer: Loose coins are pouring onto the table.

5474.about: A close shot shows a man's hands sliding a blue-green card out of a brown leather wallet beside a payment terminal with a glowing green ring in a shop. He looks up and smiles, holding the open wallet. At an open-air market he hands the card across crates of oranges, apples and plums to the stallholder while holding a paper bag. Then, over a wooden table, he holds a small brown coin purse upside down and a stream of coins pours out of it into a spreading heap. In the last shot he pushes the coins apart with one finger, sorting the copper and silver pieces on the table while the empty purse hangs in his other hand.
5474.question: What is falling onto the table?
5474.answer: Coins are falling onto the table.

5477.about: In a snowy park two structures built out of stacked snow blocks face each other across an open field, each with thick walls, corner towers and a coloured flag planted on top — one blue, one red. Children and teenagers in red and blue winter jackets, bobble hats and scarves crouch behind the snow walls, then jump up and hurl snowballs, and clouds of white snow burst over the walls. The camera runs with them as both sides charge across the open snow towards the other side's snow walls; one child in blue is knocked over and rolls in the snow, another carries the red flag on a stick along the wall. At the end the whole group lies together in a laughing heap on the snow.
5477.question: What is the boy in blue doing?
5477.answer: He is tumbling into the snow.

5479.about: A woman opens a built-in white closet full of tightly packed clothes on two rails with shoe boxes underneath. Another woman in a blue shirt pulls open the double doors of a tall wooden cupboard, revealing two rails of colourful blouses, shirts and trousers arranged by colour with storage boxes above and clear shoe boxes below. The film then cuts to a huge bright walk-in dressing room lined with shelves of folded knitwear, hanging suits and handbags: a woman stands in the doorway wearing a long champagne-coloured satin gown with wide sleeves and a tied belt reaching to her bare feet, throws her arms out wide and looks around the room in mock astonishment.
5479.question: What is the barefoot woman doing?
5479.answer: She is throwing her arms wide.

5480.about: A young man in a backwards cap stands at a kitchen sink washing a soapy plate by hand. The camera pulls back to show towers of dirty plates stacked far above his head on both sides of the sink, plus dirty cups and glasses on the counter. He keeps scrubbing plate after plate, then looks at the remaining towers, opens his mouth and groans, and the stacks are still just as high at the end.
5480.question: What is the man doing?
